```
#include "Sensors/adc_manager.h"
#include <string.h>

static volatile uint16_t s_dma_buffer[ADC_TOTAL_CHANNELS];
static ADC_HandleTypeDef *s_hadc = NULL;

void ADC_Manager_Init(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc) {
    if (hadc == NULL) return;
    s_hadc = hadc;
    memset((void*)s_dma_buffer, 0, sizeof(s_dma_buffer));

    /* Avvio conversione continua circolare con DMA */
    HAL_ADC_Start_DMA(s_hadc, (uint32_t*)s_dma_buffer, ADC_TOTAL_CHANNELS);
}

bool ADC_Manager_GetBuffer(ADC_Buffer_t *buffer) {
    if (buffer == NULL || s_hadc == NULL) return false;

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < ADC_TOTAL_CHANNELS; i++) {
        buffer->raw[i] = s_dma_buffer[i];
    }
    buffer->timestamp = HAL_GetTick();
    buffer->valid = true;
    return true;
}
```

```
#include "Sensors/filters.h"

static void sort_u16(uint16_t *arr, uint8_t len) {
    for (uint8_t i = 1; i < len; i++) {
        uint16_t key = arr[i];
        int8_t j = i - 1;
        while (j >= 0 && arr[j] > key) {
            arr[j + 1] = arr[j];
            j--;
        }
        arr[j + 1] = key;
    }
}

void Filter_Median_Init(MedianFilter_t *f, uint8_t window_size) {
    if (!f) return;
    memset(f->buffer, 0, sizeof(f->buffer));
    f->window_size = (window_size > MAX_MEDIAN_WINDOW) ? MAX_MEDIAN_WINDOW : window_size;
    if ((f->window_size % 2) == 0) f->window_size--; /* Forza numero dispari per il mediano */
    f->index = 0;
    f->count = 0;
}

uint16_t Filter_Median_Apply(MedianFilter_t *f, uint16_t new_val) {
    if (!f || f->window_size == 0) return new_val;

    f->buffer[f->index] = new_val;
    f->index = (f->index + 1) % f->window_size;
    if (f->count < f->window_size) f->count++;

    uint16_t sorted[MAX_MEDIAN_WINDOW];
    memcpy(sorted, f->buffer, f->count * sizeof(uint16_t));
    sort_u16(sorted, f->count);

    return sorted[f->count / 2];
}

void Filter_MovingAverage_Init(MovingAverageFilter_t *f, uint8_t window_size) {
    if (!f) return;
    memset(f->buffer, 0, sizeof(f->buffer));
    f->window_size = (window_size > MAX_MA_WINDOW) ? MAX_MA_WINDOW : window_size;
    f->index = 0;
    f->count = 0;
    f->sum = 0;
}

uint16_t Filter_MovingAverage_Apply(MovingAverageFilter_t *f, uint16_t new_val) {
    if (!f || f->window_size == 0) return new_val;

    if (f->count < f->window_size) {
        f->sum += new_val;
        f->buffer[f->index] = new_val;
        f->count++;
    } else {
        f->sum = f->sum - f->buffer[f->index] + new_val;
        f->buffer[f->index] = new_val;
    }
    f->index = (f->index + 1) % f->window_size;

    return (uint16_t)(f->sum / f->count);
}
```
</details></tool-use>

```
#include "Sensors/bs.h"
#include "Sensors/filters.h"

static MedianFilter_t        s_med_brake;
static MovingAverageFilter_t s_ma_brake;
static uint32_t              s_oor_start_tick = 0;

void Brake_Init(void) {
    Filter_Median_Init(&s_med_brake, BRAKE_MEDIAN_WINDOW_SIZE);
    Filter_MovingAverage_Init(&s_ma_brake, BRAKE_MA_WINDOW_SIZE);
    s_oor_start_tick = 0;
}

void Brake_Process(uint16_t raw_adc, Brake_Output_t *out) {
    if (!out) return;
    
    uint32_t now = HAL_GetTick();
    out->raw_adc = raw_adc;

    uint16_t med_val = Filter_Median_Apply(&s_med_brake, raw_adc);
    out->filtered_adc = Filter_MovingAverage_Apply(&s_ma_brake, med_val);

    bool out_of_range = (raw_adc < (BRAKE_ADC_0_BAR - BRAKE_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC)) ||
                        (raw_adc > (BRAKE_ADC_170_BAR + BRAKE_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC));

    if (out_of_range) {
        if (s_oor_start_tick == 0) {
            s_oor_start_tick = now;
        } else if ((now - s_oor_start_tick) > BRAKE_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
            out->fault_out_of_range = true;
        }
    } else {
        s_oor_start_tick = 0;
        out->fault_out_of_range = false;
    }

    if (out->filtered_adc <= BRAKE_ADC_0_BAR) {
        out->pressure_bar = 0.0f;
    } else if (out->filtered_adc >= BRAKE_ADC_170_BAR) {
        out->pressure_bar = BRAKE_MAX_SCALE_BAR;
    } else {
        out->pressure_bar = ((float)(out->filtered_adc - BRAKE_ADC_0_BAR) / 
                            (float)(BRAKE_ADC_170_BAR - BRAKE_ADC_0_BAR)) * BRAKE_MAX_SCALE_BAR;
    }

    if (out->pressure_bar < BRAKE_DEADZONE_BAR) {
        out->pressure_bar = 0.0f;
    }

    out->is_pressed      = (out->pressure_bar >= BRAKE_ACTIVE_THRESHOLD_BAR);
    out->is_hard_braking = (out->pressure_bar >= BRAKE_PLAUSIBILITY_THRESH_BAR);
}
```

```
static int16_t convert_adc_to_angle(uint16_t filtered) {
    int32_t angle = 0;

    if (filtered < SAS_ADC_CENTER) {
        /* Sterzata a Sinistra (Gradi Negativi) */
        if (filtered <= SAS_ADC_MIN) return SAS_ANGLE_MAX_LEFT_DEG;
        
        int32_t adc_range   = (int32_t)SAS_ADC_CENTER - (int32_t)SAS_ADC_MIN;
        int32_t angle_range = 0 - (int32_t)SAS_ANGLE_MAX_LEFT_DEG;
        int32_t adc_offset  = (int32_t)filtered - (int32_t)SAS_ADC_MIN;

        angle = SAS_ANGLE_MAX_LEFT_DEG + ((adc_offset * angle_range) / adc_range);
    } else {
        /* Sterzata a Destra (Gradi Positivi) */
        if (filtered >= SAS_ADC_MAX) return SAS_ANGLE_MAX_RIGHT_DEG;

        int32_t adc_range   = (int32_t)SAS_ADC_MAX - (int32_t)SAS_ADC_CENTER;
        int32_t angle_range = (int32_t)SAS_ANGLE_MAX_RIGHT_DEG;
        int32_t adc_offset  = (int32_t)filtered - (int32_t)SAS_ADC_CENTER;

        angle = 0 + ((adc_offset * angle_range) / adc_range);
    }

    /* Applicazione Deadzone attorno allo zero */
    if (angle > -(int16_t)SAS_DEADZONE_DEG && angle < (int16_t)SAS_DEADZONE_DEG) {
        angle = 0;
    }

    return (int16_t)angle;
}
```

```
#ifndef BS_H
#define BS_H

#include "main.h"
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

/* Dimensioni Finestre Filtri */
#define BRAKE_MEDIAN_WINDOW_SIZE         11U
#define BRAKE_MA_WINDOW_SIZE             16U

/* Calibrazione Teorica Aviorace SP170 + Partitore (10k / 5.17k @ 3.3V) */
#define BRAKE_ADC_0_BAR                  409U    /* ~0.33 V */
#define BRAKE_ADC_170_BAR                3681U   /* ~2.97 V */
#define BRAKE_MAX_SCALE_BAR              170.0f

#define BRAKE_ACTIVE_THRESHOLD_BAR       5.0f    /* Soglia accensione Brake Light / R2D */
#define BRAKE_PLAUSIBILITY_THRESH_BAR    20.0f   /* Soglia APPS/Brake Plausibility check */
#define BRAKE_DEADZONE_BAR               1.0f    /* Zona morta idraulica a riposo */

/* Out of Range Check (Rilevamento corto circuito / cavo tranciato) */
#define BRAKE_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC    120U    /* Tolleranza sotto 0.33V o sopra 2.97V */
#define BRAKE_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS    100U

typedef struct {
    uint16_t raw_adc;
    uint16_t filtered_adc;
    float    pressure_bar;
    bool     is_pressed;             /* Per luce stop e interlock R2D */
    bool     is_hard_braking;        /* Per  APPS > 25% + Brake */
    bool     fault_out_of_range;
} Brake_Output_t;

void Brake_Init(void);
void Brake_Process(uint16_t raw_adc, Brake_Output_t *out);

#endif /* BS_H */
```
